name: Bunch
description_en:
Bunch is currently a business-management application combining lead management, client management, tasks, HRMS and projects. The original bunchcrm.com address redirects to mybunch.ai, where Bunch is the product name and Bunzo is its AI assistant. Its CRM component follows leads through a configurable pipeline and hands won work into ongoing client context.

The platform's flat subscription is a different cost model from buying one seat for each additional employee. That makes module fit, data access and process behavior more important than a seat-price comparison alone. This profile focuses on the sales-to-client handoff, project steps, Bunzo's role and the actual advertised billing conditions. Vendor testimonials, audit/security claims and performance numbers have not been independently validated, and no workspace was operated for this research.
description_zh:
Bunch 当前是结合线索管理、客户管理、任务、HRMS 和项目的业务管理应用。原 bunchcrm.com 地址跳转到 mybunch.ai，网站使用 Bunch 作为产品名，Bunzo 为 AI 助手。其 CRM 模块让线索按可配置管线推进，再把成交工作交给持续客户背景。

平台固定订阅与每增加员工购买一个席位的计价不同，因此不能只比较席位价，还需关注模块是否适配、数据权限和流程行为。本文重点说明销售到客户的交接、项目步骤、Bunzo 职责及宣传账单条件。厂商客户证言、审计／安全主张和表现数字未独立验证，也未实际操作工作空间。

core_features.explanation_en: Create a lead in the first open stage and move it through configured stage actions; scheduling a follow-up alone does not advance it.
core_features.explanation_zh: 线索进入首个开放阶段，再由配置的阶段动作推进；仅安排跟进不会自动推进。

core_features.name_zh: 成交线索到客户的交接
core_features.explanation_en: Vendor describes creating client context from won leads with configurable field mapping and retained history.
core_features.explanation_zh: 厂商描述由成交线索建立客户背景，支持字段映射并保留历史。

core_features.explanation_en: Instantiate reusable ordered processes with step owners and checklists, then track current work and completion.
core_features.explanation_zh: 把有顺序的流程模板实例化，指定步骤负责人及清单，跟踪当前工作和完成。

core_features.explanation_en: Ask about leads, clients and work using current workspace context; actual answer/action limits remain to be tested.
core_features.explanation_zh: 利用当前工作空间背景询问线索、客户及工作，准确回答／动作限制仍待测试。

en: Track an inquiry without confusing its next follow-up with a sales-stage change.
Hand a won lead to client work and a repeatable delivery process.
zh: 跟踪咨询时区分下一次跟进与销售阶段变化。
把成交线索交给客户工作和可复用交付流程。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation tasks, not executed conversion or customer deployments.

Service model.en: Managed subscription workspace with team roles and modules. Old domain redirects to current mybunch.ai; this does not imply local hosting or source-code ownership.
Service model.zh: 具有团队角色及模块的托管订阅工作空间；旧域名跳转到当前 mybunch.ai，不代表本地托管或拥有源代码。

steps.en: Define the sales stages, team roles and lead/client field mapping for one representative process.
steps.zh: 为一条代表性流程定义销售阶段、团队角色及线索／客户字段映射。

steps.en: Bring a small spreadsheet sample and inspect ownership, duplicate handling and retained history.
steps.zh: 准备小批表格样例，检查归属、重复处理及历史保留。

steps.en: Test a won handoff and one project step under ordinary user permissions before expanding use.
steps.zh: 扩大使用前按普通用户权限测试成交交接及一个项目步骤。

items.en: A scheduled follow-up is not an automatic sales-stage transition; use the explicit stage action.
items.zh: 安排跟进不等于自动销售阶段转换，应使用明确阶段动作。

items.en: Shared module cards describe biometric payroll under Project Management, while the detailed page describes ordered project steps. The latter supplies this profile.
items.zh: 共享模块卡在 Project Management 下写生物识别薪资，而详细页描述有序项目步骤；本文采用详细页。

pricing.billing_basis: Flat workspace subscription, monthly or yearly, unlimited users advertised; listed tax and any unconfirmed scope/usage conditions separate.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: ₹4,900/month or ₹49,980/year (₹4,165/month equivalent), tax excluded; five modules and Bunzo advertised. 14-day no-card trial is separate from ongoing paid service.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 每月4,900卢比或每年49,980卢比（月均4,165），不含税；宣传含五模块和 Bunzo。14天免银行卡试用与持续付费服务不同。

faq.question_en: Is Bunch the same thing as Bunzo?
faq.question_zh: Bunch 和 Bunzo 是同一个概念吗？
faq.answer_en: The current site presents Bunch as the business platform and Bunzo as its AI assistant. Do not treat an assistant claim as every module feature.
faq.answer_zh: 当前网站将 Bunch 作为业务平台，Bunzo 为 AI 助手；不能把助手主张当作所有模块功能。

faq.question_en: Does unlimited users mean unlimited AI or storage?
faq.question_zh: 不限用户是否表示 AI 或存储也不限量？
faq.answer_en: No such entitlement was established. The pricing claims cover users and included modules; exact AI and capacity limits remain unverified.
faq.answer_zh: 尚未确立这类权益。定价主张涵盖用户和包含模块，准确 AI 及容量限制仍未核实。

official_check.scope: Public vendor documentation reviewed; no account execution, purchase, owner identity, independent review or publication approval.

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent reliability, usability or customer-outcome verification.
English and Chinese are paired drafts. Chinese text does not establish Chinese UI support.
All alternative relationships remain unreviewed. Public-web retrieval may use cached content; prices are dated observations.

sections.title_en: A follow-up is not a pipeline move
sections.title_zh: 跟进安排不等于管线移动
sections.en:
The lead module says a new lead enters the first open stage according to configured order. A call, meeting or follow-up can be scheduled while the lead remains in the same stage; an explicit stage action moves it. This is more specific than a generic automated-pipeline label.

For a hypothetical agency inquiry, record its owner and next call, then check that merely booking the call does not imply qualification. Define the evidence required for the next stage. Test an unassigned lead, a repeated inquiry and a manager view. Duplicate detection and role views are documented, but the actual matching and authorization behavior were not exercised here.
sections.zh:
线索模块说明新线索按配置顺序进入首个开放阶段。安排电话、会议或跟进时，线索可以留在原阶段，只有明确阶段动作才推进。这比笼统“自动管线”标签更具体。

以假设代理业务咨询为例，先记录负责人和下一次电话，再检查预约电话本身不会意味着已合格。应定义进入下一阶段所需证据，并测试未分配线索、重复咨询及经理视图。文档描述重复检测和角色视图，但本文未实际验证匹配及授权行为。

sections.title_en: Carry history into ongoing client work
sections.title_zh: 把历史带入持续客户工作
sections.en:
The client page describes turning a Won lead into a client, carrying contacts and activity history with configurable field mapping. The useful evaluation is whether the account team can understand the relationship without reconstructing calls and notes from a second tool.

Check a lead with multiple contacts and a non-default owner, then inspect the resulting primary contact, mapped fields and earlier timeline. The page calls conversion retry-safe; that remains a vendor claim until repeated conversion and recovery are tested. A created client record is not proof that service delivery, billing or external systems have completed the handoff.
sections.zh:
客户页描述把 Won 线索变为客户，携带联系人和活动历史，并可配置字段映射。评估重点是客户团队能否直接理解关系，无需从第二个工具重建电话和备注。

应检查多联系人及非默认负责人的线索，再核对生成客户的主要联系人、映射字段和此前时间线。页面称转换可安全重试，但在重复转换及恢复测试前，这仍是厂商主张。创建客户记录，不证明交付、计费或外部系统已完成交接。

sections.title_en: Projects use a copied process with current-step ownership
sections.title_zh: 项目复制流程，并明确当前步骤负责人
sections.en:
The detailed Projects page describes reusable ordered templates with roles, durations and checklists. Starting a project gives it its own process copy; the current step has an assigned person, and finishing required work advances the next step. The final completed step marks the project complete according to the vendor's description.

For a pilot, create a short delivery process and inspect reassignment, an overdue step and an incomplete checklist. Do not infer complex resource accounting or regulatory payroll behavior from a generic module card. The shared homepage/pricing cards put biometric-payroll wording under Projects, which conflicts with the detailed page; the latter is the evidence used here.
sections.zh:
详细 Projects 页描述带角色、时长和清单的可复用有序模板。项目启动后拥有自己的流程副本，当前步骤指定人员，完成必需工作后进入下一步骤；厂商说明最终步骤完成即标记项目完成。

试点可用短交付流程检查重新分配、逾期步骤及未完成清单。不能从通用模块卡推断复杂资源核算或法规薪资能力。首页／定价共享卡将生物识别薪资文字放在 Projects 下，与详细页冲突；本文采用后者作为证据。

sections.title_en: Use Bunzo as an answer/action path with checks
sections.title_zh: 将 Bunzo 作为需核对的问答／动作路径
sections.en:
Bunzo is described as using live workspace information across leads, clients and work, with questions that can lead to follow-up actions such as tasks. It is part of the platform's advertised bundle, not a replacement name for every business module.

Compare an answer with the underlying record, including a stale field and a user who should not see another team's client. Review any proposed task before treating it as authorized business work. This is evaluation advice, not a claim that a permission failure was observed. Model/provider details, usage caps, audit behavior and action approval rules were not established or tested.
sections.zh:
Bunzo 被描述为使用线索、客户及工作等实时工作空间信息，问题可引出任务等后续动作。它属于平台宣传组合的一部分，不是所有业务模块的新名称。

建议把回答与原始记录对照，包含过时字段，以及不应看见其他团队客户的用户，并在把任务当作获授权工作前核对其内容。这是评估建议，不表示观察过权限失败。模型／服务商、额度、审计行为及动作批准规则未得到确立或测试。

sections.title_en: A flat workspace price still needs billing conditions
sections.title_zh: 固定工作空间价格仍需看账单条件
sections.en:
The pricing page advertises ₹4,900 monthly for the workspace, or ₹49,980 paid yearly, equivalent to ₹4,165/month, excluding listed tax. Unlimited users, all five modules and the AI agent are advertised together. As an arithmetic comparison, twelve monthly payments total ₹58,800; the stated annual bill is ₹8,820 lower, before tax or unconfirmed extras. This is not a measured customer saving.

The page offers a 14-day trial without a card. Terms describe advance recurring fees, generally non-refundable payments and trial-to-paid conversion wording. Confirm the actual account's billing state and cancellation rules instead of assuming that trial access is ongoing free use. User count is the unlimited dimension; storage, AI, API and external service allowances remain to be established.
sections.zh:
定价页宣传工作空间每月4,900卢比，或按年付49,980卢比，月均4,165，不含所列税费；宣传组合包括不限用户、全部五模块和 AI 助手。以算术比较，12次月付合计58,800卢比，所列年付低8,820，未计税或未确认附加项。这不是实测客户节省。

页面提供14天免银行卡试用；条款说明预付续费、通常不可退款及试用转付费措辞。应核对实际账户账单状态和取消规则，不能假定试用等于持续免费。不限量维度是用户数，存储、AI、API 和外部服务额度仍需确定。

sections.title_en: Keep the wider suite and operating responsibility in view
sections.title_zh: 同时考虑更广套件与运行责任
sections.en:
Bunch is a relevant candidate when a business wants sales-to-client context and repeatable work in one workspace, with wider people/operations modules available. If the need is only a narrow lead list or a specialized HR/payroll system, verify the required depth instead of assuming bundled breadth means equivalent specialist capability.

The terms grant a limited revocable service license and restrict extracting source code; this is not an open-source/self-hosting offer. They also leave customers responsible for critical backups. Exact exports, restore guarantees, integrations, data location, UI languages and regional payment access were not verified. The original bunchcrm.com redirect and current brand/domain are recorded here; coordinator-owned indexes need the canonical-domain update during integration.
sections.zh:
业务希望在同一空间连接销售到客户背景及重复工作，并使用更广人员／运营模块时，可评估 Bunch。如果只需很窄线索表或专业 HR／薪资系统，应验证具体深度，不能因打包范围广就推断等同专门工具。

条款授予有限可撤销服务许可并限制提取源代码，不是开源／自行托管方案；同时要求客户自行负责关键备份。准确导出、恢复保证、集成、数据位置、界面语言及地区付款未核实。本文记录原 bunchcrm.com 跳转和当前品牌／域名，整合时需由协调方更新其负责的规范域名索引。

seo.title_en: Bunch: Sales-to-Client Workflows, Bunzo AI and Flat Pricing
seo.title_zh: Bunch：销售到客户流程、Bunzo AI 与固定价格
seo.description_en: Understand the current Bunch platform at mybunch.ai, explicit sales stages, client conversion, step-based projects, Bunzo and flat workspace billing.
seo.description_zh: 了解 mybunch.ai 上当前 Bunch 平台、明确销售阶段、客户转换、步骤项目、Bunzo 及固定工作空间计费。
seo.primary_intent: Identify current Bunch CRM scope and evaluate connected sales/client/project work.
secondary_questions: Does scheduling a follow-up advance a lead?
What happens when a lead is won?
What is unlimited in the flat plan?
seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no keyword demand, ranking or AI citation measurement.

research_gaps.en: No workspace, import, conversion, project step, permission, Bunzo action or billing event was run. Usage limits, export/restore, integration semantics, data location, UI languages and regional payments unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 未运行工作空间、导入、转换、项目步骤、权限、Bunzo 动作或计费事件；用量限制、导出／恢复、集成语义、数据位置、界面语言和地区付款未核实。

research_gaps.en: Shared module-card wording conflicts with the detailed Projects page, and trial billing wording differs between pricing and terms. Signed/account-specific conditions need confirmation.
research_gaps.zh: 共享模块卡与详细 Projects 页文字冲突，定价和条款的试用计费措辞也不同，需确认签署／具体账户条件。
